tests.title: 2D entry does not request the 3D module or model
a stalled 3D module times out before mounting and can recover after arrival
repeated modes, stages and real context loss preserve the session
switching to 2D during a pending model request allows a clean retry
a real 30-second load timeout falls back and permits retry
touch look survives a second finger and cancellation; controls remain tappable
narrow controls, keyboard look and resize preserve the loaded scene
